rationale: Issue #432 repairs the existing generic customer-education publication path so one reviewed publication can expose named concept components with bounded evidence and customer boundaries. The repository loader remains backward-compatible, and the Health v0 application may select only caller-governed component IDs after validated semantic interpretation. Cross-concept component proposals fail closed. This reuses the existing education-publication authority rather than creating a new insurance capability.
authority_impact: No insurance, product, entitlement, claim, payment, or recommendation authority is added. Education components remain CUSTOMER_EDUCATION-only content bounded by the parent EducationPublicationRecord and its admitted evidence references. GSI selects request meaning only, and Rendering Exit Safety remains the final customer-release authority.
